fieldNotes.truckGate: Single landscaped entrance boulevard off Hazeltine National Dr feeds a controlled, fully-fenced campus; Street View cannot enter the property and the truck approach is screened by hedge/berm with yellow bollards and a checkpoint. Controlled gated entry confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Driver reviews of this DC explicitly reference a staffed 'guard station' ('nice guys at guard station'); consistent with a manned booth at the truck check-in on the entrance drive. Booth itself is screened by landscaping in satellite, so footprint not directly resolved.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Continuous dock banks run along multiple faces of the warehouse complex (long west face plus north/return faces); refrigerated DCs of this size typically split inbound/outbound across distinct dock clusters. Marked uncertain — exact ship vs rcv split not visually confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. West face alone is a continuous bank of dozens of doors with trailers backed in across a ~700 ft wall; additional dock banks on adjoining faces. Count of 110 is an honest overhead estimate, not exact.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Extensive marked trailer rows on the west apron and a second drop block to the SE; overnight driver parking is advertised. trailersVisible (~180) and capacity (~320) are approximate counts from zoom-20/21 imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance boulevard with palm-lined median and ample paved width at the gate apron leaves physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound at the gate apron from the boulevard width; not precisely resolvable through landscaping. exitLanes ~1.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved yard between the gate/office plaza and the dock face provides post-gate holding before doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach across the internal yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus comprises the main 720k SF refrigerated warehouse plus a central ammonia refrigeration plant and ancillary buildings (Whiting-Turner project notes 9 buildings); treated as a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 72.4 ac is the traced fenced/paved operational core. Public project pages cite a ~120-acre full campus including retention ponds, buffers, and undeveloped land.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lee Vista / Orlando International Airport industrial corridor, dense metro industrial fabric — Urban.
